title: Hybrid per-vector + batch-credit pricing prototype for embeddings and rerank
creator: Nina Park
description: Proposal and experiment plan for a hybrid pricing model that combines a low per-vector baseline with batch-credit bundles and a separate rerank delta price. Goal: reduce unit price for high-volume batch indexing while protecting per-request economics for low-volume real-time use, and offer enterprise-friendly commit options for Dedicated/Private customers. This ticket covers product spec, pricing tiers, contract language drafts, QSA checklist updates, pilot selection criteria, and success metrics.

decisions: Adopt hybrid pricing baseline: $0.0006 per vector for on-demand calls, with optional prepaid batch-credit bundles that reduce effective per-vector price based on batch size buckets.
Rerank pricing will be a separate SKU priced per 1k rerank ops with a discounted multiplier when rerank is executed as part of a batch-credit job (rerank-delta model).
Pilot to run as a time-boxed A/B with 5 customers: 3 midsize, 2 enterprise. Each pilot customer signs a 3-month pilot contract with opt-in true-up.
Require security/QSA artifacts and sample contract language before enabling batch credits for Private deployments. Legal to approve minimum commit clauses for Dedicated customers.
Technical implementation will surface a billing tag 'apply_batch_credit' at the ingestion layer; if unavailable fallback to per-vector billing.
